answer: The spiral register is checked at draw time, ridge lists the eligible set, and cedar seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 20 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 20 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Collateral of 85 dollars is at risk. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
